caption:
5 Things I Will NEVER Do For My Mental Health 

#usahealth #chinesemedicineworks #healthybodyhealthymind #healthy #mental
transcript: Here are five things I will never do for my mental health. Listen closely. These lessons took me years to learn. 1. I will never trade my peace for approval. Peace is the highest form of wealth and nothing is worth losing it. 2. I will never walk beside people who do not walk beside me. When you carry a relationship alone, your spirit becomes exhausted. Energy must flow both ways. 3. I will never silence my heart when it asks to be heard. Your heart whispers before it screams. Ignoring those whispers is how you drift away from yourself. 4. I will never hold on to stories that no longer strengthen me. The past is a teacher, not a place to live. Let go of what no longer helps you grow. 5. I will never forget that healing is a daily practice. Transformation happens in small choices, small thoughts, gentle awareness. This is how you begin to become whole again. If you're ready to start your own healing journey, I created a 30-day healing journey to guide you step by step. You can join it through the link in my profile.
